highlights: Historischer Ansitz an der Zugspitz Arena
tipps: Kombinieren Sie den Spaziergang mit einem Abstecher zu den drei Biberwierer Gebirgsseen Mittersee, Blindsee und Weißensee.
kurzbeschreibung: The historic manor in Biberwier at the foot of the Fernpass bears witness to the location's centuries-old role as a rest and toll station on the Fernpass.
beschreibung:
Historic Hub on the Fernpass Route

At the foot of the prominent Wettersteingebirge lies the tradition-steeped municipality of Biberwier. The local historic manor and fortifications along the Fernpass route served for centuries as an essential base for travelers and wagoners along the Via Claudia Augusta.

Mining History and Alpine Mountain Panorama

Alongside transit traffic, lead and zinc mining formerly shaped village life. Surrounding the manor, magnificent views open up toward the Ehrwalder Sonnenspitze and the mighty Zugspitze massif, nestled within the picturesque natural setting of the Tyrolean Zugspitz Arena.
